KIT logo (data URI)

Source: R/setup.R
kit_logo_uri.Rd

Goes straight into the page (no static file path to set up). The logos are transparent PNGs in inst/logo/.

Usage

kit_logo_uri(size = 96, kind = c("mark", "logo"))

Arguments

size

Pixels: the bean ("mark") comes in 64, 96, 256, "h512", "h1024"; the full logo ("logo", bean plus KIT wordmark) comes in 128, 192, "h512", "h1024" (height). The header uses the vector logo (kit_logo_file()); this function gives a PNG to embed in the page.

kind

"mark" is the bean only (browser tab icon); "logo" is the full logo (header).

Value

"data:image/png;base64,..."; "" when that size does not exist.

Examples

substr(kit_logo_uri(64), 1, 30)
#> [1] "data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0K"
